sourceImageReading.scope: Exact final HTML in an isolated mobile browser; source-image enlargement, scrolling and close/focus restoration.

passed: Independent mathematical, hint, concept and follow-up review for the precise release scope.
Actual Normal and Pearson paper interfaces at desktop/mobile widths: all originals and follow-ups, hints, checked answers, retries, next, final first/after scores and reload.
Local-fixture numbered attempts, account separation, manager read-only presentation, stale iframe rejection and historical edition/concept pinning.
Implemented public-roadmap archive, hide/remove and restore flows preserve answers/history/content.
Public Mock source guards reject purchased Exam Sets and retain source attribution.
Enlarged source questions preserve readable intrinsic dimensions and allow two-axis scrolling while keeping Back to practice reachable.
Build and all listed content, mapping, follow-up, player and regression gates.
unsupported: Historical exposure through the old unmapped two-question Mock D preview is not used to reduce full-paper concept credit; separate answer and attempt storage is tested.
This release does not supply an authenticated worker that automatically prepares uploaded PDFs.
Permanent deletion of papers, attempts and source files is not implemented; supported public-roadmap hide/remove remains reversible.
unverified: Production logins, credentials, real cloud permissions and cross-device synchronisation were not exercised; account and cloud-runtime checks use isolated local fixtures.
Mobile browser checks use Chromium viewports; native iOS/Android, Safari and Firefox were not exercised.
GitHub Pages deployment is checked after push and is not claimed by this pre-publication report.

resolvedIssues.observed: Earlier parallel and serial browser runs contained intermittent action timeouts. Their logs were retained locally.
resolvedIssues.resolution: The same candidate passed the final complete sequential browser checks and full regression suite without changing product code. The cause of the earlier timeouts was not established. Separately reviewed fixture corrections are listed in testingInvestigation.

uiRuns.result: Previously failing combination passed isolated with diagnostics enabled
Fresh complete serial run8passed,352exercise instances,868hint pieces; unchanged10s action limits and original assertions

testingInvestigation.cause: No cause established for intermittent locator timeouts. Parallel load was reduced, but one serial timeout also occurred; no product change was made to hide failures. Final complete serial pass is recorded without claiming a proven cause.

fixtureCorrections.finding: The app stores attemptNumber only after activity; the new fixture incorrectly expected1on an untouched record.
fixtureCorrections.correction: Assert untouched record has no attemptNumber; first full-paper answer gets1; first answer after preview restart gets2.

fixtureCorrections.finding: The fixture waited for visible question text while the completed preview correctly displays its finished screen.
fixtureCorrections.correction: Explicitly wait for the finished screen on that return route; other opens still require question text.
